Definition: neuter of G40; a sacred thing (i.e. spot):--holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.
BiblicalUsage: Hágion is the neuter of hágios, a holy thing or a holy place, and it stands in Hebrews 9:1 for the worldly sanctuary of the first covenant. In Matthew 7:6 it is the holy thing not to be given to dogs, and in 1 Peter 2:5 it is the holy priesthood believers are built into.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hágion means a holy thing, a holy place, the sanctuary, and I leave it at that.
